quarterly_data.quarter: Uber press release: Uber to Acquire ezCater as it Brings Catering to Uber Eats (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Uber agreed to acquire ezCater, a U.S. platform for catering and workplace meals whose customers order from over 140,000 restaurants nationwide, bringing catering to Uber Eats alongside Uber for Business. Per the release, ezCater generated over $2.5 billion in Gross Bookings over the trailing twelve months, growing high teens year-over-year, is profitable on a Non-GAAP Operating Income basis and is expected to be margin accretive; its average order values are over $400. The transaction is expected to close in the coming months, subject to regulatory approvals.
quarterly_data.figure: ezCater over $2.5 billion TTM Gross Bookings (growing high teens); over 140,000 restaurants; average order value over $400
